findings.consequence: Later admission may accept 960 seconds for an interrupted child whose unresolved lifetime was longer. Group absence now does not prove an earlier exit time. Full cumulative-cost preservation after controller SIGKILL remains unestablished.
findings.minimal_falsifier: Create a v2 START 3600 seconds in the past, PROCESS, no RECEIPT, and a legacy reconciliation with exact hashes, absent pgid and charge 960. It must not permit cumulative admission. A sufficient dated reconciliation may permit later admission while leaving the original task consumed.
findings.missing_control: No added test exercises typed v2 START plus PROCESS, absent RECEIPT, and legacy reconciliation charging less than unresolved elapsed time. The four new methods cover the existing-receipt and snapshot paths.
findings.observed_behavior: V2 detection occurs only inside the receipt.exists() branch. With no receipt, typed v2 START falls through to the legacy reconciliation, which requires charged_new_seconds >= 960 but no reconciled timestamp or charge covering the interval through verified cleanup. A valid hash-bound start/process and current absent group suffice.

read_only_probe.interpretation: Demonstrates an accepted underbounded reconciliation, not a claim that a real reviewed solver consumed 3600 seconds.
read_only_probe.method: Actual attempt_terminal with mocked filesystem snapshots and killpg absence, no child launch or persistent mutation.

findings.required_condition_for_closure: V2 missing-receipt attempts must remain blocked or use a hash-bound reconciliation with dated absence/cost evidence covering the unresolved interval or an independently proved earlier terminal time. Legacy v1 semantics, original task/binding and first failures must remain intact.
findings.title: V2 attempts without a terminal receipt still use the weaker legacy cost reconciliation
findings.trigger: A v2 controller is killed after START/PROCESS but before RECEIPT, leaving its solver group alive beyond the controller watchdog. The group is later stopped and a legacy RECONCILIATION.json is supplied.
